courses.title: Kubernetes Local Lab
courses.description: A hands-on Kubernetes course where you set up a real K8s cluster on your local machine. Learn pods, services, deployments, and ingress through curated practical exercises drawn from real enterprise environments.
courses.prerequisites: Basic Linux command line, familiarity with Docker
courses.requirements: A machine with at least 8GB RAM, Docker installed

courses.title: Networking for Software Engineers
courses.description: Demystify the networking concepts every software engineer needs: DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TCP/IP, SSL certificates, proxies, and more. Built around real-world scenarios you will actually encounter on the job.

courses.title: Django REST API Masterclass
courses.description: Build production-grade REST APIs with Django Rest Framework. Covers authentication, serialization, performance optimization with caching, and full deployment to a cloud server.

courses.title: DevOps with Docker & CI/CD
courses.description: Learn containerization with Docker, multi-service orchestration with Docker Compose, and automated CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions. Go from writing code to deploying it with every push.

courses.title: Cloud DevOps Engineering
courses.description: End-to-end cloud infrastructure: deploy applications on AWS, manage infrastructure with Terraform, set up monitoring and alerting, and implement security best practices used in real enterprise environments.
courses.prerequisites: Linux basics, Docker experience, some DevOps exposure
courses.requirements: AWS free tier account, laptop with at least 8GB RAM
